equivalence.predicate: Before and after, (i,j) is connected iff i and j occur in at least one identical common spectator bucket.
equivalence.row_order: Rows ascending; sorted unique row neighbors gives same row-major order as sorted(i*D+j).
equivalence.triangular: Bucket index lists are ascending because built by enumerate(dets); old combinations_with_replacement yields exactly col>=row. New filter is identical.
equivalence.low_active_number: min(2, active occupation count) preserved. Empty list exhausts; vacuum/singleton has diagonal; 1 active electron uses same one-electron removal. Duplicate masks remain distinct determinant indices.
equivalence.physical_scope: Equal-particle-number determinant blocks from native CI. No radial or angular coefficient formula, frozen mask, signed phases, pruning policy, configuration, or basis changes.

full_4f12_connection_only_admission.finding: Global pair set/sorted-list/output-list removal makes a 2 GiB bounded connection-only trial meaningful, but does not prove it fits.
full_4f12_connection_only_admission.unknown_memory: Number/bitwidth of distinct spectator integer keys, hash-table capacity, Python list headers/capacity and allocator fragmentation remain unmeasured.
full_4f12_connection_only_admission.required_scope: One sector per fresh worker or explicit lifetime end; consume generator incrementally; do not list(), cache emitted pairs, form angular table, H, projection, NumPy determinant array, or launch all sectors simultaneously.
full_4f12_connection_only_admission.gate: Compare full count/deterministic row order/rolling content digest against predeclared integer census; stop on cap/time/hash/model mismatch. Memory cap failure is retained data, not permission to reduce physical space.
full_4f12_connection_only_admission.not_authorized_by_this_review: No full 4f12 Hamiltonian or CI memory admission and no performance speedup claim.
full_4f12_connection_only_admission.bucket_count_lower_bound_from_Cauchy: For largest membership K=23456895 and ordered bucket-pair visits V=92428751, number of nonempty buckets U >= ceil(K*K/V) = 5952974. This is an integer bound, not allocated buckets or RSS.

new_insight: No new general insight; existing exact-sparsity, complete identity, bounded-resource and signed-equivalence rules cover this increment.

typed_CSR_implemented_review.storage: FP64 angular data, int64 typed column IDs/row pointers/flat pair coordinates. No Python triplet list or COO row-index array retained.
typed_CSR_implemented_review.dynamic_keys: Existing first-encounter dictionary kept. Final shape uses actual key count; row pointers append once per retained connection.
typed_CSR_implemented_review.canonicalization: sum_duplicates plus sort_indices after direct CSR construction. No eliminate_zeros; duplicate cancellation remains an explicit stored zero exactly as prior CSR conversion.
typed_CSR_implemented_review.complex_callback: One-time real-to-complex128 promotion interleaves original real values with exact zero imaginary parts; later values retain both real and imaginary parts. Native Coulomb/Breit angular data remain real.
typed_CSR_implemented_review.complex_radial: Public evaluate_block complex radial values remain separate from real angular table. integral_dtype validation and transpose symmetry behavior unchanged.
typed_CSR_implemented_review.buffer_lifetime: np.frombuffer views own backing memoryviews/arrays; local variable expiry does not invalidate returned CSR data or coordinate views. int64-to-int32 SciPy conversion can allocate extra index arrays; count actual peak.
typed_CSR_implemented_review.empty: Typed zero-length data/indices, indptr[0], shape(0,1), pairs reshape(-1,2) preserve prior empty shape.
typed_CSR_implemented_review.numerical_validation: Not executed by read-only reviewer; independent tests and full A/B benchmark owned by sibling/root.

benchmark_prepare_review.identity_gates: All40 worker-block identities must exactly match first old-worker identity; synthetic signed action/bilinear <=1e-10 and abs-amplitude negative control >1e-8.
